conventions.cpu: duplicate-write prompt mirror, independent LRU, no GPU-eviction admission; no invalidation of GPU on CPU eviction
conventions.prefix: GPU contiguous full-block prefix then CPU contiguous extension; remainder recomputed; partial tail never cached
conventions.timing: keys ready and CPU writes only at request completion; GPU pins + private output reservation; FCFS slot/KV queue
conventions.initialization: same M/G/infinity instances and tau as capacity; empty caches at t=0; skipped history not preloaded; is_entry excluded
conventions.throughput: stationary raw demand times simulated token-weighted miss fraction; actual window tps reported separately
conventions.limitations: fixed .5s service; instantaneous transfers; no decode-time model or vLLM chunk-transfer/admission detail; no guarantee of shared-GPU stability
